notes: Evidence shows XPO as a pure North American LTL carrier; its other businesses were divested or spun off.

logistics_role.detail: Moves palletized LTL freight across US, Canada, Mexico and Caribbean through its terminal network.

asset_intensity.detail: Asset-based: owns tractors, trailers, terminals, builds its own trailers, trains its own drivers.

value_added.detail: Specialty LTL services: guaranteed delivery, exclusive-use trailers, trade show, retail appointment, coordinated pickup, customs support.
